items.source: The default implementation does use MessageFormat, through delegating to the AbstractMessageSource.resolveCode(String, Locale) method. Subclasses are encouraged to replace this with optimized resolution.
items.translation: 默认实现确实使用 MessageFormat，通过委托给AbstractMessageSource.resolveCode(String, Locale)方法。鼓励子类用优化的解析方式替换此实现。

items.source: Subclasses are encouraged to provide optimized resolution for messages without arguments, not involving MessageFormat. See the AbstractMessageSource.resolveCodeWithoutArguments(String, Locale) javadoc for details.
items.translation: 鼓励子类为不涉及 MessageFormat 的无参数消息提供优化的解析。有关详细信息，请参阅 AbstractMessageSource.resolveCodeWithoutArguments(String, Locale) javadoc。

items.source: Unfortunately, java.text.MessageFormat is not implemented in an efficient fashion. In particular, it does not detect that a message pattern doesn't contain argument placeholders in the first place. Therefore, it is advisable to circumvent MessageFormat for messages without arguments.
items.translation: 不幸的是，`java.text.MessageFormat` 的实现效率不高。特别是，它无法检测消息模式本身是否包含参数占位符。因此，建议对于不含参数的消息，避免使用 MessageFormat。

items.translation: 返回一个 MessageFormat 实例而不是消息字符串，以便在子类中适当缓存 MessageFormat。
